market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Oil at $108 and firming Fed hike bets create headwinds. Stocks climbing into Fed decision but vulnerable to oil/yield spikes. Consumer data mixed. Expect volatility around next week's Fed meeting. Mortgage rates >7% suppress housing. Diesel at $6 pressures transport and logistics margins.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle drives productivity gains but debt accumulation is a medium-term risk. Energy transition continues despite China pullback. US $40T debt is structural concern. Trade wars add uncertainty. If inflation peaks and Fed pivots, equities recover. Physical metals and energy remain structural beneficiaries.
